prompt:
The first reference picture is the photograph to retouch. The second and third reference pictures show the young woman in the light-blue denim jacket: her face, her dark blonde hair tied back in a ponytail and her build stay exactly as in them.

The photograph is retouched in one way only: the young woman in the light-blue denim jacket now stands on the NEAR pavement in the foreground, instead of in front of the bakery.

In front of the bakery, the whole bakery window with its bread on wooden shelves, the open bakery door and the pale pavement are now in view, with nobody there.

On the near pavement, she stands between the traffic-light pole and the parked bicycles at the bottom right of the picture, right beside the bicycles, whose handlebars come up to her waist. Seen from the first-floor window above her, she holds her phone in front of her chest with both hands and looks down at its screen, her eyebrows drawn together: she is looking for her way. We see her whole, from her head to her shoes, which stand on the paving stones with their shadow under them, above the bottom edge of the picture. She is in her light-blue denim jacket, white T-shirt and dark jeans, and the bicycles, the traffic-light pole and the red cycle lane stay visible around her.

Everything else in the photograph stays exactly as it is, in the same place, the same size and the same light: the facades and their windows, the pharmacy with its green cross, the post office, the café with its dark-red awning, tables and chairs, the bus stop and its shelter, the woman in the red coat, the white bus, the two parked cars and the parking meter, the blue signs, the traffic lights, the delivery lorry, the zebra crossing and the two pedestrians on it, the taxi, the yellow tram, the motorbike, the cyclist in the yellow jacket, the kiosk, the yellow mailbox and the street lamp.
